description: Measures that later stages compute and report. Each metric names the fields it reads, how it is worked out in words, and what the data shows today. No metric has a target value. A PROPOSED bound from the baseline is recorded as a note with Owner: Team-Force. It is not a target.

metrics.name: tokens per invocation
metrics.description: How many tokens one model call used.
metrics.formula: The token figure stored on one call row. For a set of calls, the sum of token figures divided by the number of calls.
metrics.live_source: The live body returns token_estimate, computed as len(prompt.split()) * 2. The value for REC-0001 was 64. The gateway does not write the CSV, so the two figures never meet.
metrics.today: The CSV holds 353 numeric token_count values. The SIMULATED sum in the cost envelope is 845675. That sum is a lab figure.

metrics.name: cost per correlated incident
metrics.description: How much the model calls for one incident cost, once alarms have been tied to that incident.
metrics.formula: The sum of cost figures for the calls whose incident_id is this incident, divided by one incident. Cost comes from events cost_units or from a hosted-model price that is Unknown.
metrics.today: The join from alarms to incidents is Unknown, so no incident is correlated yet. events.jsonl has cost_units with an Unknown money unit. The hosted-model price is Unknown. This metric cannot be computed today.

metrics.name: quarantine rate
metrics.description: The share of rows a batch held aside as bad instead of passing them on.
metrics.formula: Rows held aside divided by rows processed, for one batch run.
metrics.today: etl/run_daily_batch.py printed processed 354 and malformed 1. It held nothing aside. It writes no file of bad rows. So the rate today is 0 of 354, while 1 row is known bad. Where a held-aside row would go is Unknown.

metrics.name: retry count
metrics.description: How many times a service order build was tried again.
metrics.formula: The retry_count value on one order row. For a set of orders, the minimum, maximum, and the count at or above a bound.
metrics.today: 353 numeric values. Minimum 32. Maximum 4995. 294 at or above 1000. ORD-00002 has 4052.
metrics.proposed_bound_note: The baseline uses 1000 as a PROPOSED bound so the odd case is counted. Owner: Team-Force. It is not an approved maximum and not a target.

metrics.name: audit completeness
metrics.description: How much of a full decision record each audit row holds.
metrics.formula: For one audit row, the count of required fields that are filled divided by the count of required fields. Required fields are ts, action, actor, correlation_id, record_id, and, for a model call, model, approval_id, and policy_result.
metrics.live_source: logs/audit.log rows hold ts, action, and details. details holds record_id and role for a read, record_id and model for a summary.
metrics.today: A record.read row fills ts, action, record_id, and a role string. An ai.summary row fills ts, action, record_id, and model. No row has actor, correlation_id, approval_id, or policy_result.
metrics.required_fields_note: The required-field list above is PROPOSED. Owner Team-Force. Stage S05-14 confirms it. The repo does not define a full decision record.

metrics.name: recommendation latency
metrics.description: How long a model call takes from request to answer.
metrics.formula: The time the answer arrived minus the time the request was sent, in milliseconds, for one call.
metrics.live_source: The live gateway waits time.sleep(0.01) and returns. It records no latency on the body or the audit row. The provenance field latency_ms in ai-context-policy.yaml adds it.
metrics.today: events.jsonl holds latency_ms on every line. No live call records it.

metrics.name: SLA breach risk
metrics.description: A stored score for how likely the service promise on an incident will be broken.
metrics.formula: The sla_breach_risk value on one incident row. The repo does not say how the score is made.
metrics.today: 352 values between 0 and 1. INC-00019 holds 1.42. One cell blank.
metrics.proposed_bound_note: The baseline uses 0 to 1 inclusive as a PROPOSED range. Owner: Team-Force. It is not an approved range and not a target.

metrics.name: alarm storm size
metrics.description: How many alarms share one storm batch.
metrics.formula: The count of alarm rows with the same storm_batch_id, after rows with the same dedupe_key are counted once.
metrics.today: 351 distinct storm_batch_id values. Three appear twice. The largest batch in the file is 2 rows. How many alarms make a storm is Unknown.

metrics.name: AI outcome count
metrics.description: How many model calls ended in each of the four outcomes.
metrics.formula: For each outcome word, the count of calls whose outcome field holds that word.
metrics.today: No live call records an outcome. The CSV columns guardrail_status and approval_required hold the generic status words, not the four outcome words. This metric is 0 for all four outcomes today.
